# Donadomains

> Domain search aggregator that compares prices across 6 registrars in real-time. Find the cheapest place to buy any domain, or look up who owns it.

Base URL: https://donadomains.xyz

## What We Do

Donadomains searches domain availability across multiple registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun) in real-time. We return:

- Availability status for any keyword across all common TLDs
- Live pricing from each registrar with direct buy links
- The cheapest registrar highlighted automatically

## API — 2 Endpoints

No authentication required. Free and open.

### 1. Domain Search

GET /api/search?q={keyword}

Search for domain availability and compare prices. Returns a JSON response with results from 6 registrars.

Parameters:
- q (required): Search keyword like "example" or full domain like "example.com"
- stream (optional): Set to "true" for Server-Sent Events streaming

Example: GET /api/search?q=myproject

Response:
{
  "keyword": "myproject",
  "tld": null,
  "results": [
    {
      "domain": "myproject.com",
      "available": true,
      "tld": ".com",
      "matchType": "exact",
      "buyLinks": [
        { "name": "GoDaddy", "url": "https://...", "price": "$0.01/yr", "priceNum": 0.01, "isCheapest": true, "source": "scraped" },
        { "name": "Namecheap", "url": "https://...", "price": "$5.98/yr", "priceNum": 5.98, "source": "scraped" }
      ],
      "registerUrl": "https://..."
    },
    {
      "domain": "myproject.xyz",
      "available": false,
      "tld": ".xyz",
      "matchType": "exact",
      "buyLinks": []
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    { "name": "GoDaddy", "status": "ok", "count": 31 },
    { "name": "Namecheap", "status": "ok", "count": 6 }
  ]
}

### 2. Domain Info

GET /api/domain/{domain}

Get detailed intelligence about a single domain. Uses RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS.

Example: GET /api/domain/example.com

Response:
{
  "domain": "example.com",
  "registered": true,
  "registrar": "RESERVED-Internet Assigned Numbers Authority",
  "created": "1995-08-14T04:00:00Z",
  "expires": "2025-08-13T04:00:00Z",
  "nameservers": ["a.iana-servers.net", "b.iana-servers.net"],
  "status": ["client delete prohibited", "client transfer prohibited"],
  "sources": ["rdap", "dns"],
  "timing": { "rdap": 342, "dns": 87 }
}
